facts.value: Machine design refers to the procedures and techniques used to address the three phases of a machine's lifecycle.

facts.description: Involves the identification of a need, development of requirements, concept generation, prototype development, manufacturing, and verification testing.
Involves enhancing manufacturing efficiency, reducing service and maintenance demands, adding features and improving effectiveness, and validation testing.
Involves the decommissioning and disposal phase and includes recovery and reuse of materials and components.
